A silk-worker in the Separatist congregation at Leiden, where he married Alice Carpenter in 1613.
He did not sail on the Mayflower, and died in London about 1620.
Of Wrington, Somerset. Married Edward Southworth among the Separatists at Leiden in 1613.
Widowed, she came to Plymouth on the Anne in 1623 and a few weeks later married Governor William Bradford.
Died at Plymouth 26 March 1670, nearly eighty.
